piper.exe, piper_phonemize.dll
  Piper TTS 2023.11.14-2 - https://github.com/rhasspy/piper - MIT License

espeak-ng.dll, espeak-ng-data/
  eSpeak NG (rhasspy fork) - https://github.com/rhasspy/espeak-ng
  GNU General Public License v3.0 or later. Source code: https://github.com/rhasspy/espeak-ng
  Full license text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt
  Dictionaries for languages not used by SWEAXCUT were removed (unmodified otherwise).

onnxruntime.dll, onnxruntime_providers_shared.dll
  ONNX Runtime - https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime - MIT License

voices/tr_TR-fahrettin-medium.onnx (+ .json)
  Piper voice "fahrettin" (medium). Dataset: NabuCasa voice-datasets, CC0.
  https://huggingface.co/speaches-ai/piper-tr_TR-fahrettin-medium

SWEAXCUT runs piper.exe as a separate process; it is not linked into the application.
